# Mini config for unit/integration testing
# READ1 = DPM only (first tag, zero laxity)
# READ2 = Y | SPACER(3) | ODD (laxity=2)

READ1 = DPM
READ2 = Y|SPACER|ODD
SPACER = 3
LAXITY = 2

# DPM tags — exact match, 8 bp
DPM	DPM_A	AAAACCCC	0
DPM	DPM_B	GGGGTTTT	0

# Y tags — exact match, variable length (8 and 7 bp to exercise multi-length)
Y	Y_1	TTTTAAAA	0
Y	Y_2	CCCCGGG	0

# ODD tags — 1 mismatch allowed, 8 bp
ODD	Odd_1	ATCGATCG	1
ODD	Odd_2	GCTAGCTA	1
